outcomes.name: The capability and confidence has been refined based on pilot learnings
The capability and confidence is understood across every site/team joining the scaled rollout

actions.action: Review pilot feedback on Skills & Behaviour to identify what needs to change in the capability and confidence before scaling.
Refine the capability and confidence to Skills & Behaviour based on lessons learned from the pilot.
Secure sign-off for the refined capability and confidence covering Skills & Behaviour ahead of wider rollout.
Ensure the refined capability and confidence for Skills & Behaviour is consistently communicated to new sites/teams joining the rollout.
Continuously validate that the capability and confidence for Skills & Behaviour remains effective as the change scales further.
Gather feedback from pilot participants on how the capability and confidence affected People Experience & Culture.
Adapt the capability and confidence relating to People Experience & Culture for a wider, more diverse audience.
Roll out the capability and confidence covering People Experience & Culture to stakeholders in newly onboarding sites/teams.
Monitor People Experience & Culture among stakeholders in the wider rollout and address any gaps.
Use champions from the pilot to help new sites/teams connect with the capability and confidence for People Experience & Culture.
